viewing_check: Photograph the engine plate and model number (Ducar model, engine maker: real Kawasaki or generic), check pull-start/key-start works and the battery, look for oil leaks, fuel in the tank and rust, check outlets and the control panel. If it starts and holds load, it is worth more; if seized or not running, treat as parts.
